summary.en: Immunology remains central, while myeloma bispecifics, solid-tumor ADCs and retinal gene therapy broaden the late-stage portfolio. Apogee and external partnerships also extend the dermatology and obesity pipeline.
summary.zh: 免疫仍是研发核心，多发性骨髓瘤双抗、实体瘤 ADC 和视网膜基因疗法拓宽后期布局；Apogee 收购及外部合作进一步补充皮肤病和肥胖管线。

ind.en: Relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after at least two prior lines
ind.zh: 既往接受至少两线治疗的复发或难治性多发性骨髓瘤

next.zh: 三线骨髓瘤适应症潜在获批

ind.en: Nonsegmental vitiligo (US filing); also alopecia areata filed
ind.zh: 非节段型白癜风(美国申报);斑秃亦已申报

next.en: Regulatory submissions supported by extension data
next.zh: 以延长期数据支持上市申报

ind.en: Refractory metastatic colorectal cancer with bevacizumab; also NSCLC
ind.zh: 与 bevacizumab 联用治疗难治性转移性结直肠癌；亦开发非小细胞肺癌

next.zh: III 期结直肠癌数据读出

target.zh: 癫痫相关同源蛋白 SEZ6

ind.zh: 复发或难治性小细胞肺癌

target.zh: AAV8 递送的抗 VEGF Fab

ind.en: Wet age-related macular degeneration; also diabetic retinopathy
ind.zh: 湿性年龄相关性黄斑变性；亦开发糖尿病视网膜病变

next.en: ATMOSPHERE and ASCENT topline data; filings expected in 2027
next.zh: ATMOSPHERE 和 ASCENT 顶线数据；预计2027年申报

ind.zh: 特应性皮炎；亦开发哮喘
肥胖症及慢性体重管理

watch.en: The Q3 filing describes approximately 100 programs, about 60 mid/late-stage; immunology remains a key focus alongside neuroscience and oncology.
watch.zh: Q3 文件披露约100个项目，其中约60个处于中后期；免疫与神经科学、肿瘤仍是重点领域。

watch.en: Lutikizumab’s INTREPID trial was positive; AbbVie plans HS regulatory submissions in the second half of 2027.
watch.zh: Lutikizumab 的 INTREPID 研究取得阳性结果，AbbVie 计划于2027年下半年申报化脓性汗腺炎适应症。

watch.en: The completed Apogee acquisition adds IL-13 antibody zumilokibart and an IL-13/TSLP combination program.
watch.zh: 已完成的 Apogee 收购补充了 IL-13 抗体 zumilokibart 及 IL-13/TSLP 联合项目。

watch.en: REGENXBIO’s November update expects joint sura-vec pivotal data in Q4 2026 and global submissions in 2027.
watch.zh: REGENXBIO 的11月更新预计，双方将在2026年第四季度披露 sura-vec 关键数据，并于2027年全球申报。

sources: AbbVie Science: etentamig / ABBV-383 / TNB-383B aliases
gaps: The corporate pipeline page did not expose its asset table to the browser; the complete October 30 investor pipeline PDF was used instead. No full phase-count series was verified; counts is null.

Origins of lutikizumab, Temab-A and ABBV-706 remain unverified; origin is null. Upadacitinib is explicitly described as discovered and developed by AbbVie in the 2018 release, used only for provenance.
The 2021 TeneoOne release predates 2026-06 and is used only for acquisition origin; current stage and BLA come from Q3 2026 materials.

No dated next milestone was verified for ABBV-706, zumilokibart or ABBV-295; next is null. Zumilokibart remains Phase 2 in the October pipeline grid despite being described broadly as late-stage in the results release.
REGENXBIO’s November 2026 update brings the subretinal sura-vec readout to Q4 2026; this newer partner disclosure is used over the October AbbVie slide timing.
Reproxalap was excluded from the selected items: AbbVie holds an option rather than an exercised license, and Aldeyra is appealing a complete response letter. Approved tavapadon is excluded.
The supplied checker rejects null phase/origin values although the research brief permits them; unsupported values are retained as null rather than invented to satisfy validation.
